en_excerpt: A handy list of English classes, training centres and business supports in Co. Laois, with links and contacts to make your search easier.
en_meta_description: English classes, training centres and supports for jobseekers and entrepreneurs in Co. Laois, Ireland, with useful links.
en_content:
Here is a list of places in Co. Laois, Ireland, where you can find English courses, other languages, professional training, upskilling for the job market and support for entrepreneurs, with links and contacts to make your search easier 👇

 

📘 English and Other Language Courses

🗣️ Language Schools and Centres

Our Courses Ltd – English courses and general training in Carlow (close to Laois).

🌐 Website: http://www.ourcourses.com/

Solenn’s School of French and English – English and French classes in Rathdowney.

🌐 Website: http://solennsschool.com//

 

Carlow International English Language School – English school in Carlow (within reach of Laois).

🌐 Website: http://www.ciels.ie/

 

Equinox Education Services Ltd – English courses with international support.

🌐 Website: https://equinoxlearnabroad.com/

 

📌 English Centre in Portlaoise / Laois

LOETB Information Hub and Laois and Offaly Education and Training Board – the Education and Training Board (LOETB) has several options, including English for Speakers of Other Languages (ESOL) and English courses for adults. Visit the courses section on their website to check availability and enrolment. 

Laois County Council

 

🎓 Professional Upskilling and General Training

💼 Training and Skills Development Centres

Pitman Training Laois – Professional training courses (administration, business, software, etc.).

🌐 Website: https://www.pitman-training.ie/laois

 

Portarlington Further Education and Training Centre – Adult training and further qualifications.

🌐 Website: http://portarlingtonfetc.ie/

 

Portlaoise Further Education and Training Centre – Technical courses and general training.

🌐 Website: https://www.loetb.ie/portlaoise-fetc

 

Abbeyleix Further Education Centre – Adult education and local training.

🌐 Website: https://abbeyleixfetc.ie/

 

Further education center (loetb) mountmellick – Further training in Mountmellick.

National Learning Network Portlaoise – Help with getting into the job market and professional training.

🌐 Website: https://rehab.ie/centres/national-learning-network-portlaoise/

 

Metac Training – A range of practical and technical courses.

🌐 Website: http://metac.ie/

 

SafetyTraining.ie – Safety certifications and courses (useful for work).

🌐 Website: https://safetytraining.ie/

 

Kearney Training & Consultancy (KTC Safety) Ltd – Technical and professional training.

🌐 Website: http://www.ktcsafety.ie/

 

ProLash Ireland – Courses and professional development.

🌐 Website: http://www.prolashireland.com/

 

On The Job Training – Hands-on practice and training in a real workplace.

🌐 Website: https://onthejobtraining.ie/

 

Laois Partnership Company is the local community development company for County Laois. It is funded by the Irish State and the European Union and works to improve the lives of people and communities in the region. 

laoispartnership.ie

 

What it does:

🔹 Promotes community and social development – it helps make Laois a better place to live and work. 

🔹 It delivers programmes such as:

• LEADER Programme – supports rural projects, initiatives and new businesses with funding and mentoring. 

• SICAP (Social Inclusion Community Activation Programme) – support for social inclusion and employment. 

• Community Employment, Tús and Rural Social Schemes – pathways into work and support for vulnerable groups. 

• Integration programmes for newcomers (for example, English classes and integration support). 

• Support for older people, families and local community initiatives. 

 

The organisation works with local groups, offers small grants, helps people into employment and supports communities that feel left out.
